UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private learner study profile storing target IELTS band, exam date, and completed roadmap steps.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Learner display name shown inside the workspace.

targetBand.description: Target overall IELTS band score (4.0 to 9.0).

examDate.description: Target IELTS exam date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

completedRoadmapSteps.description: Bounded list (max 24) of completed 12-week study roadmap step IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

Attempt.title: Attempt
Attempt.description: Immutable record of a completed Reading, Listening, Writing, or Speaking practice session.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner who completed the attempt.

skill.description: IELTS exam skill practiced in this attempt.

testId.description: Identifier of the practice test or prompt attempted.

testTitle.description: Human-readable title of the attempted Cambridge-style test.

band.description: Calculated IELTS band score from 0.0 to 9.0.

scoreText.description: Compact raw score summary (e.g., 7/8 correct or 268 words).

durationSec.description: Elapsed attempt duration in seconds (0 to 14400).

summary.description: Actionable rubric or solution breakdown for review in app/results.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was submitted.

CustomTest.title: CustomTest
CustomTest.description: Admin-managed Cambridge-style practice bank item published to the workspace library.

skill.description: Target IELTS skill for this test item.

source.description: Source bank label such as Cambridge IELTS 20.

title.description: Title of the passage, listening section, writing prompt, or cue card.

published.description: Whether this item is visible to signed-in learners.

authorUid.description: Admin UID who created this item.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Server-provisioned RBAC marker identifying platform administrators.

/users/{userId}.description: Private learner profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/attempts/{attemptId}.description: Subcollection of immutable four-skill IELTS practice attempt records for a learner.

/testBank/{testId}.description: Admin-managed Cambridge-style practice bank items readable by verified signed-in users when published.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted RBAC marker collection for test bank administrators (read-only from client).
